title: Inadequate URL protocol whitelist in link sanitization
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** Medium  ## Description  In `ExplorerLink.tsx` and `ManageChainsItem.tsx`, user-controlled URLs (e.g. the txPage template or the chain’s website field) are passed directly through xss() and rendered into an `<a href="…">` without validating the URL scheme. While the xss library escapes dangerous characters, it does not enforce a protocol whitelist by default.  An attacker who can manipulate the link template can supply a javascript: URI (for example, `"javascript:alert(document.cookie)"`), resulting in DOM-based XSS when a user clicks the link.
